references.text: God revealed Himself to Moses in the burning thorn bush, and "he who dwells in the thorn bush" refers to this event where God called Moses.
Jacob's blessing over Joseph contains similar language about blessings from the earth and describes Joseph as set apart from his brothers (nazir).
The preceding verses in the same blessing over Joseph describe the good gifts of the earth that complement this verse.
Joseph was chosen and separated from his brothers, which is fulfilled in the description "the consecrated one among his brothers."
The earth and everything that fills it belongs to the Lord, reflecting the expression "the earth and its fullness."
Stephen refers to the burning thorn bush in his speech, where God revealed Himself as "he who dwells in the thorn bush."
